author: Inside Edition
description: There was outrage nationwide about an alleged scandal at prestigious Cornell University in New York. In a lawsuit filed two weeks ago, a female student claims seven male students at the Ivy League college drugged and sexually assaulted her in 2024. On Monday, after the woman’s allegations generated widespread criticism, the district attorney said his office will reopen the investigation and reconsider its decision not to file criminal charges. He added that the original statement provided by the woman to police did not warrant criminal charges but he would now let a grand jury decide. Inside Edition's Ann Mercogliano has the latest.
title: D.A. To Reopen Investigation Of Alleged Gang Rape At Ivy League Fraternity

author: Inside Edition
description: A California homeowner told Inside Edition she thinks the people who stole a safe from her house had some help.
title: Did A Delivery Driver Tip Off House Thieves? #shorts

author: Inside Edition
description: Major delivery apps all require drivers to undergo mandatory background checks. But are some food delivery drivers with questionable backgrounds bypassing those safeguards by buying or borrowing other drivers' accounts? One North Carolina mom tells Inside Edition she was outraged after learning a convicted sex offender delivered food to her twelve-year-old son. “You’re supposed to be able to trust who you’re ordering from,” she told us.
title: Do You Know Who’s Really Delivering Your Food?

author: Inside Edition
description: He's barely a teenager at 13, but Joe Petraro-Hyppolite of Long Island is way ahead of most students his age. He's already in college, set to graduate in March of 2027. While he may have been born gifted, he says he still has to put in the work to achieve this much academic success. He just reached another milestone, getting accepted to a Master's Program at New York University. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: 13-Year-Old Genius Gets Accepted To Master's Program At NYU
